ui:help.en: Root address of the New API site; each protocol goes to its official path under it. A trailing /v1 or /v1beta is removed.
ui:help.zh: 填 New API 站点的根地址，各协议按官方路径拼在它后面；末尾的 /v1 或 /v1beta 会被去掉。

ui:help.en: A token of the site. The balance includes the user's quota only if the token allows querying the user's quota on the site. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ui:help.zh: 站点的令牌。查用户余额需要在上游给这个令牌开启"允许查询用户额度"。加密保存，保存后不再明文显示。
